remarks: Come take a tour of this spacious condo apartment located within the secure Hayes House Condominiums. Walk into an open floor plan for your living room/ dining room area. Beautiful electric fireplace and private balcony for you to enjoy! The kitchen is fully equipped with all stainless steel appliances. Unit also features one large bedroom, and a stunning marble bathroom with spa shower! Common area laundry room available on-site, plus additional basement storage. Easy access to popular downtown area, and close to highways and the train station- perfect for NY commuters! Rent includes heat, hot water, air conditioning, water, and gated parking space! Building includes a 24/7 doorman, inviting lobby, access to a fitness center ($15/month per person), a community room, and large exterior deck for outdoor entertaining! No pets and No smoking. All tenants 18yrs and older must complete a full rental application which includes proof of income, references, and credit/background check. Tenant will need to contact HOA Management to arrange move in/ move out.
